confidence_notes: Six searches used: one RBA lookup and five Bangkok price checks. The RBA rate (18 Nov 2026) was read from a search summary of RBA pages; I did not open the page myself. Restaurant meals (about THB 100 inexpensive, about THB 1,250 mid-range for two; Numbeo-style figures that may be dated) and cappuccino (about THB 105; typical range 60-130) are best supported. Beer (about THB 110) is mostly judgement: only blog and menu ranges were found (large local bottle about THB 80-100 at local restaurants, hotels much higher). Cocktail (about THB 300) and wine glass (about THB 285) rest on thin 2026 venue and guide ranges (cocktails roughly 200-420, wine roughly 200-500) and a 2.6-2.7x beer multiple. THB was converted to USD at an assumed 33 THB per USD from general knowledge, not looked up. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate for a July low-season window; no accommodation searches or listings were checked, and Bangkok hostel-private, 1-star and 3-star prices overlap widely.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city used. Estimates combine Bangkok-specific price ranges from the searches with general knowledge of large Southeast Asian tourist cities. Wine and cocktails are priced at roughly 2.6-2.7x beer, reflecting Thailand's relatively high alcohol taxes.
